The InterLink Token Treasury: The Standard for Human-Verified Digital Assets
As the digital economy shifts toward Web3 and AI-driven solutions, the distinction between "bot" and "human" has become the world’s most valuable currency. The InterLink Token Treasury is a financial and strategic framework that allows forward-thinking companies to secure their position in this new "Human-First" economy by holding InterLink Token ($ITLG) as a reserve asset.

Below is an educational breakdown of what the Treasury is, why it is essential for modern enterprises, and the ecosystem backing it.

1. What is the InterLink Token Treasury?
The InterLink Token Treasury is a decentralized reserve system where corporations, financial institutions, and platforms hold InterLink Tokens ($ITLG) to secure access to the "Human Layer" of the internet.

Unlike traditional crypto treasuries that are purely speculative, the InterLink Treasury is utility-backed. It represents a stake in the Proof of Personhood network—a global infrastructure that verifies human identity without compromising privacy. Companies use this treasury to:

Pay for "Human Verification" services (to clean their own platforms of bots).

Reward real users for data contribution.

Access the InterLink Data Layer for training high-fidelity Human-AI models.

2. Why Companies Choose InterLink Token as a Reserve Asset
Major enterprises are moving $ITLG into their reserves not just as an investment, but as a strategic utility asset. Here is why:

A. The "Human Standard" for AI Integrity
With the rise of Deepfakes and AI spam, companies need a way to verify real interactions. InterLink is ranked among the Top 113 Human-AI models worldwide by NIST (National Institute of Standards and Technology). Holding $ITLG gives companies priority access to this NIST-validated verification standard, ensuring their own ecosystems remain bot-free.

B. Global Reach & Liquidity
The network is already massive and battle-tested.

4.5 Million+ Real Users (Verified Humans)

3 Million Daily Active Users (High Engagement)

Presence in 131 CountriesBy holding InterLink Tokens, companies instantly tap into a global, verified user base for customer acquisition and loyalty programs.

C. Institutional Validation
Confidence in the asset is high due to its rigorous backing. InterLink is backed by Google for Startups, ensuring top-tier infrastructure and scalability. Furthermore, the project’s credibility was highlighted by an invitation for an interview at the NYSE (New York Stock Exchange), signaling readiness for traditional capital markets.

3. Requirements and Benefits of Being an InterLink Token Reserve
To become a recognized Treasury Partner, companies typically must meet specific holding and compliance criteria to ensure the integrity of the network.

Requirements
Minimum Holding Period: Companies must commit to holding a percentage of their $ITLG allocation for a vesting period (ensuring long-term alignment).

Verified Business Identity (KYB): Just as users provide Proof of Personhood, Treasury Partners must pass "Know Your Business" checks to prevent bad actors from influencing the Human Layer.

Ecosystem Integration: Partners are required to integrate InterLink’s verification SDK or payment rails into at least one consumer-facing product.

Benefits
Zero-Knowledge Identity Access: Partners can verify their own customers without handling sensitive personal data (GDPR compliant).

Reduced Transaction Fees: Treasury Partners receive discounted rates on all InterLink Network transaction fees.

Ambassador Network Access: Direct access to 8,000+ Ambassadors worldwide to launch local marketing campaigns.

AI Training Data: Priority access to "Human-labeled" data sets for training corporate AI models, ensuring high accuracy and low bias.

4. InterLink’s Ecosystem & Treasury Partners
The InterLink ecosystem is powered by strategic collaborations with some of the world's largest technology and infrastructure firms. These companies are exploring, utilizing, or building upon the InterLink framework to secure the future of digital identity.

Strategic Collaborators & Ecosystem Partners:

Samsung: Collaborating on hardware-level security and verification standards.

Google for Startups: Providing infrastructure backing and acceleration resources.

Meituan: Utilizing the network for scalable, high-volume user verification.

Toshiba & Canon: Partnering on advanced biometric imaging and recognition technologies.

Kakao: Integrating social-layer verification to enhance user trust.

Note: Several publicly listed companies on Nasdaq and NYSE have actively expressed interest in establishing formal Treasury positions to hedge against digital fraud and secure human-verified user bases.

Summary:
The InterLink Token Treasury is more than a crypto fund; it is a trust anchor for the AI era. By combining NIST-ranked technology with a massive user base of 4.5M+ verified humans, InterLink offers companies a unique way to asset-back their commitment to a transparent, bot-free digital future.
#InterLink #ITLG #ITL

Happy 20th birthday to the gorgeous, hugely talented Singer, Songwriter, Rapper, Dancer, Actor, TV Host, Superstar, Top Model and Fashion & K-Pop Global Icon, the One & Only NI-KI!👏🎂🎉🌟🌎👑🖤🎆 
#NIKI found fame as the Main Dancer, Vocalist, Rapper and Ace Maknae of the massively popular chart-topping, history-making group #ENHYPEN, one of the best-selling K-Pop Acts of the Era! NI-KI, whose real name is Nishimura Riki (西村 力), was born in Okayama, Japan, and brings a unique flair to the group with his exceptional dance skills, his breathtaking performances and powerful charisma onstage, contributing greatly to the band's success. He is widely regarded as a "4th-generation dance prodigy" for his precision, speed, and stage control. He can memorize complex choreography in 10 minutes, often earning center positions in performances. He's the best dancer in ENHYPEN according to members and fans, with 9 fancams surpassing 1 million YouTube views in 2022 and now one of Korea's best! He's also insanely handsome, and ranked #24 on TC Candler’s Most Handsome Faces of 2020 and was renominated in 2021. He is a real musician and can play the piano, and has been actively participating in ENHYPEN’s music creation since 2022. He is registered with the Korea Music Copyright Association (KOMCA) under Nishimura Riki (西村力) and as of December 2025, has 15 songs credited to his name! 

NI-KI discovered his passion for dance when he was just 3, inspired by Michael Jackson videos. At the age of 5, he joined a dance academy, training in hip-hop, jazz, and ballet. In 2019, at just 13, he moved to South Korea to train as a Jazz and ballet dancer He began his music career as a dancer for SHINee, and was soon nicknamed  'Super Dancer' and 'the Little Michael Jackson' for his amazing dance moves! His Motto is “Dance is life”! NI-KI rose to prominence on the 2020 survival show I-LAND, impressing everyone with his skills, and earning the title of "I-LAND's No. 1 Dancer" and praise from industry pros like BTS's J-Hope, SEVENTEEN's The8, and choreographer Son Sung-deuk. He ranked 4th in the global finale on September 18, 2020, with 1,140,718 votes, securing his spot in ENHYPEN. Ni-ki officially debuted as a member of ENHYPEN on November 30, 2020. ENHYPEN's debut album BORDER: DAY ONE sold 280,073 copies in its first week, setting the record for the highest first-week sales by a 2020 K-pop rookie group. Within two weeks of their debut, the band won the 'Next Leader Award' at the 2020 Fact Music Awards, and the album was certified Platinum by the Korea Music Content Association (KMCA)! Their 2nd EP, 'Border: Carnival',  was released on April 26, 2021 in conjunction with the lead single "Drunk-Dazed", and sold over 450,000 units in pre-orders alone! 'Border: Carnival' debuted atop the Oricon Albums Chart, the group's first chart-topper in Japan, and hit No. 18 on the US Billboard 200 and No. 9, 4 & 4 on the Billboard World Albums, Top Album Sales & Top Current Album Sales! Their first studio album, 'Dimension: Dilemma', was released on October 12, 2021, and hit #1 on both the Oricon Album Chart in Japan and Gaon Album Chart in Korea and #11 on the Billboard 200, selling over 1.1 million units on Gaon! ENHYPEN released 'Dimension: Answer', a repackaged version of Dimension: Dilemma, on January 10, 2022 which peaked at #1 on both the Gaon and Oricon Albums Chart, and earned their third top 20 entry on the Billboard 200, at #13, and 3rd consecutive #1 on the Billboard World Albums chart! The album spawned the smash hit "Blessed-Cursed", their first to top the Gaon Download Chart! The group set a record for the most entries (6) on Billboard's Hot Trending Songs Weekly! Their 3rd EP, 'Manifesto: Day 1', was released on July 4, and became their 2nd million-selling album, making them the fastest K-pop group to become 2 Million sellers! In September 2022, Enhypen kicked off their first world tour in Seoul which was extended to February 2023! Their 4th EP, 'Dark Blood' was released on May 22 2023 and sold over 1.1 million copies in its first day becoming their 1st album to debut in the Top 5 on the Billboard 200! In July 2023 they kicked off their 2nd world tour which was extended for several extra US and Japan dates till May 2024! Their 2nd studio album 'Romance: Untold' dropped on July 12, 2024 and hit #1 in Japan and Korea, certified 2X Platinum in Korea for over 2.5M units, and hit #2 on the Billboard 200, becoming their 2nd Top 5 Album in America. It was the best-selling k-pop album in 2024 and the 2nd best-selling album worldwide after Taylor Swift's 'The Tortured Poets Dept' as per IFPI with sales of 3.4 Million sales units! On April 10, 2025, Enhypen made their U.S.A. TV debut with a performance of "Loose" on "Jimmy Kimmel Live!", before blowing the world away at Coachella on April 12 and 19,  breaking the record for the most viewed live performance by a K-pop group in Coachella's history, attracting over 400,000 viewers! Their 6th mini-album, 'Desire: Unleash' was released on June 5 and topped the Circle chart in Korea with 2,19M units, the Oricon chart in Japan with 305K units and landed at #3 on the Billboard 200 with 95K units, the best-selling album that week in the US! It's Enhypen's 3rd double-million seller!

NI-KI has contributed significantly to ENHYPEN's award-winning success since their 2020 debut. His  amazing dance skills and charisma onstage have been instrumental in securing numerous honors including 8 MAMA Awards and the Daesang Award this year for Fans' Choice of the Year, 7 Golden Disc Awards, 6 Fact Music Awards, 5 D Awards, 4 Seoul Music Awards, 3 Hanteo Awards, 3 Circle Chart Music awards, 3 Asia Star Entertainer Awards, 2 MelOn Music Awards, 2 Japan Gold Disc Awards and 2 Asia Artist Awards! ENHYPEN won Artist of the Year (Bonsang) twice at the Fact Music Awards, Album of the Year (Daesang) and Best Group and Best Tour at the D Awards, Grand Prize at the Asia Star Entertainer Awards (ASEA), Best Album, Fan's Choice, and Global K-pop Artist at the 39th Golden Disc Awards, and Artist of the Year (Bonsang) for 3 Years in a row at the Hanteo Music Awards! When the Group first began, they won all the Rookie of the Year Awards across major ceremonies ie. Melon Music Awards, MAMA & Golden Disc Awards and the Worldwide Fans' Choice Top 10 at MAMA.

As ENHYPEN's maknae and a Superstar in the K-pop scene, NI-KI has leveraged his global appeal, especially in fashion, beauty, and Japanese markets for several high-profile endorsements. While many of his deals are tied to the group, he has secured a few standout solo roles, particularly in 2025. These partnerships highlight his youthful energy, dance prowess, and cross-cultural charm. In 2021, he became a house ambassador with ENHYPEN for AMI Paris, a French casual-luxury brand, targeting Gen Z with chic, inclusive outfits. In May, 2022 ENHYPEN was chosen for the 2022 Coke summer campaign artist for "Coke X Music. In March 2022, NI-KI became the face of Nike Air Max and Nike Manoa Leather Boots! In 2023, he became a Global Ambassador with ENHYPEN for Korean skincare leader Dr. Jart+ in 2023 they also became global ambassadors for Prada, setting a record at the recent Milan Fashion Week (MFW) Spring/Summer 2026 Womenswear show by generating the highest media impact value ($18.29M EMV) among all influencers and celebrities present! In 2024, Enhypen were chosen as the new model image of the Japanese mail-order retailer Peach John for their new spring unisex room wear as part of their 30th anniversary special project. In 2024 they were also announced as brand ambassadors for Dunkin' Philippines. Since 2024, NI-KI is a Muse to Bulgari and is invited to various events and has been featured in family-style campaigns, and modelled jewelry showcases in Tokyo and Rome including the B.Zero1 collection. In March 2025, NI-KI was appointed to represent the Digital Hollywood University's programs in digital arts, film, and design. The campaign was launched with NI-KI in promotional visuals, inspiring young creatives, fitting his background in dance and performance arts. In May 2025, he became the brand ambassador for the Japanese Energy drink ZONe ENERGY, as the face of the brand's "REALIZE (ENERGY Vers.)" campaign, aligning with his high-energy performances. NI-KI featured in promotional photos and videos, promoting vitality and youth empowerment. This marks his first major solo beverage endorsement. This year, along with the other members of ENHYPEN, NI-KI was announced as the new global ambassador of the skincare brand Mixsoon.

NI-KI's philanthropic efforts, underscores his supportive role in using ENHYPEN's platform for positive impact. As a member of ENHYPEN, he has consistently supported disaster relief, health awareness, and environmental causes, with NI-KI participating as a core member. In November 2025, he contributed to ENHYPEN's ₩100 million ($68,000) donation for Philippine flood recovery, targeting Bulacan, the site of their 2025 stadium concert. During MAMA awards, he took part Part in HYBE Labels APAC's ₩2.65 million HKD (~$341,000) donation to the Hope Bridge Korea Disaster Relief for families of the Hong Kong Fire Disaster. NI-KI's global fanbase (Nikitties) contributed additional funds in his honor.

NI-KI is a role model for countless young dancers, after rising from a small-town dance prodigy in Okayama, Japan, to become one of K-pop’s most celebrated fourth-generation talents in just five years! He has helped propel the group to over 20 million albums sold, and million-seller status with every release!

ICON OF DREAMS NI-KI

#니시무라_미역국마니무라 
#ニキ20歳の誕生日
@ENHYPEN
@ENHYPEN_members

He is a real musician and can play the piano, and has been actively participating in ENHYPEN’s music creation since 2022. He is registered with the Korea Music Copyright Association (KOMCA) under Nishimura Riki (西村力) and as of December 2025, has 15 songs credited to his name! NI-KI discovered his passion for dance when he was just 3, inspired by Michael Jackson videos. At the age of 5, he joined a dance academy, training in hip-hop, jazz, and ballet. In 2019, at just 13, he moved to South Korea to train as a Jazz and ballet dancer He began his music career as a dancer for SHINee, and was soon nicknamed 'Super Dancer' and 'the Little Michael Jackson' for his amazing dance moves! His Motto is “Dance is life”! NI-KI rose to prominence on the 2020 survival show I-LAND, impressing everyone with his skills, and earning the title of "I-LAND's No. 1 Dancer" and praise from industry pros like BTS's J-Hope, SEVENTEEN's The8, and choreographer Son Sung-deuk. He ranked 4th in the global finale on September 18, 2020, with 1,140,718 votes, securing his spot in ENHYPEN. Ni-ki officially debuted as a member of ENHYPEN on November 30, 2020. ENHYPEN's debut album BORDER: DAY ONE sold 280,073 copies in its first week, setting the record for the highest first-week sales by a 2020 K-pop rookie group. Within two weeks of their debut, the band won the 'Next Leader Award' at the 2020 Fact Music Awards, and the album was certified Platinum by the Korea Music Content Association (KMCA)! Their 2nd EP, 'Border: Carnival', was released on April 26, 2021 in conjunction with the lead single "Drunk-Dazed", and sold over 450,000 units in pre-orders alone! 'Border: Carnival' debuted atop the Oricon Albums Chart, the group's first chart-topper in Japan, and hit No. 18 on the US Billboard 200 and No. 9, 4 & 4 on the Billboard World Albums, Top Album Sales & Top Current Album Sales! Their first studio album, 'Dimension: Dilemma', was released on October 12, 2021, and hit #1 on both the Oricon Album Chart in Japan and Gaon Album Chart in Korea and #11 on the Billboard 200, selling over 1.1 million units on Gaon! ENHYPEN released 'Dimension: Answer', a repackaged version of Dimension: Dilemma, on January 10, 2022 which peaked at #1 on both the Gaon and Oricon Albums Chart, and earned their third top 20 entry on the Billboard 200, at #13, and 3rd consecutive #1 on the Billboard World Albums chart! The album spawned the smash hit "Blessed-Cursed", their first to top the Gaon Download Chart! The group set a record for the most entries (6) on Billboard's Hot Trending Songs Weekly! Their 3rd EP, 'Manifesto: Day 1', was released on July 4, and became their 2nd million-selling album, making them the fastest K-pop group to become 2 Million sellers! In September 2022, Enhypen kicked off their first world tour in Seoul which was extended to February 2023! Their 4th EP, 'Dark Blood' was released on May 22 2023 and sold over 1.1 million copies in its first day becoming their 1st album to debut in the Top 5 on the Billboard 200! In July 2023 they kicked off their 2nd world tour which was extended for several extra US and Japan dates till May 2024! Their 2nd studio album 'Romance: Untold' dropped on July 12, 2024 and hit #1 in Japan and Korea, certified 2X Platinum in Korea for over 2.5M units, and hit #2 on the Billboard 200, becoming their 2nd Top 5 Album in America. It was the best-selling k-pop album in 2024 and the 2nd best-selling album worldwide after Taylor Swift's 'The Tortured Poets Dept' as per IFPI with sales of 3.4 Million sales units! On April 10, 2025, Enhypen made their U.S.A. TV debut with a performance of "Loose" on "Jimmy Kimmel Live!", before blowing the world away at Coachella on April 12 and 19, breaking the record for the most viewed live performance by a K-pop group in Coachella's history, attracting over 400,000 viewers! Their 6th mini-album, 'Desire: Unleash' was released on June 5 and topped the Circle chart in Korea with 2,19M units, the Oricon chart in Japan with 305K units and landed at #3 on the Billboard 200 with 95K units, the best-selling album that week in the US! It's Enhypen's 3rd double-million seller! NI-KI has contributed significantly to ENHYPEN's award-winning success since their 2020 debut. His amazing dance skills and charisma onstage have been instrumental in securing numerous honors including 8 MAMA Awards and the Daesang Award this year for Fans' Choice of the Year, 7 Golden Disc Awards, 6 Fact Music Awards, 5 D Awards, 4 Seoul Music Awards, 3 Hanteo Awards, 3 Circle Chart Music awards, 3 Asia Star Entertainer Awards, 2 MelOn Music Awards, 2 Japan Gold Disc Awards and 2 Asia Artist Awards! ENHYPEN won Artist of the Year (Bonsang) twice at the Fact Music Awards, Album of the Year (Daesang) and Best Group and Best Tour at the D Awards, Grand Prize at the Asia Star Entertainer Awards (ASEA), Best Album, Fan's Choice, and Global K-pop Artist at the 39th Golden Disc Awards, and Artist of the Year (Bonsang) for 3 Years in a row at the Hanteo Music Awards! When the Group first began, they won all the Rookie of the Year Awards across major ceremonies ie. Melon Music Awards, MAMA & Golden Disc Awards and the Worldwide Fans' Choice Top 10 at MAMA. As ENHYPEN's maknae and a Superstar in the K-pop scene, NI-KI has leveraged his global appeal, especially in fashion, beauty, and Japanese markets for several high-profile endorsements. While many of his deals are tied to the group, he has secured a few standout solo roles, particularly in 2025. These partnerships highlight his youthful energy, dance prowess, and cross-cultural charm. In 2021, he became a house ambassador with ENHYPEN for AMI Paris, a French casual-luxury brand, targeting Gen Z with chic, inclusive outfits. In May, 2022 ENHYPEN was chosen for the 2022 Coke summer campaign artist for "Coke X Music. In March 2022, NI-KI became the face of Nike Air Max and Nike Manoa Leather Boots! In 2023, he became a Global Ambassador with ENHYPEN for Korean skincare leader Dr. Jart+ in 2023 they also became global ambassadors for Prada, setting a record at the recent Milan Fashion Week (MFW) Spring/Summer 2026 Womenswear show by generating the highest media impact value ($18.29M EMV) among all influencers and celebrities present! In 2024, Enhypen were chosen as the new model image of the Japanese mail-order retailer Peach John for their new spring unisex room wear as part of their 30th anniversary special project. In 2024 they were also announced as brand ambassadors for Dunkin' Philippines. Since 2024, NI-KI is a Muse to Bulgari and is invited to various events and has been featured in family-style campaigns, and modelled jewelry showcases in Tokyo and Rome including the B.Zero1 collection. In March 2025, NI-KI was appointed to represent the Digital Hollywood University's programs in digital arts, film, and design. The campaign was launched with NI-KI in promotional visuals, inspiring young creatives, fitting his background in dance and performance arts. In May 2025, he became the brand ambassador for the Japanese Energy drink ZONe ENERGY, as the face of the brand's "REALIZE (ENERGY Vers.)" campaign, aligning with his high-energy performances. NI-KI featured in promotional photos and videos, promoting vitality and youth empowerment. This marks his first major solo beverage endorsement. This year, along with the other members of ENHYPEN, NI-KI was announced as the new global ambassador of the skincare brand Mixsoon. NI-KI's philanthropic efforts, underscores his supportive role in using ENHYPEN's platform for positive impact. As a member of ENHYPEN, he has consistently supported disaster relief, health awareness, and environmental causes, with NI-KI participating as a core member. In November 2025, he contributed to ENHYPEN's ₩100 million ($68,000) donation for Philippine flood recovery, targeting Bulacan, the site of their 2025 stadium concert. During MAMA awards, he took part Part in HYBE Labels APAC's ₩2.65 million HKD (~$341,000) donation to the Hope Bridge Korea Disaster Relief for families of the Hong Kong Fire Disaster. NI-KI's global fanbase (Nikitties) contributed additional funds in his honor. NI-KI is a role model for countless young dancers, after rising from a small-town dance prodigy in Okayama, Japan, to become one of K-pop’s most celebrated fourth-generation talents in just five years! He has helped propel the group to over 20 million albums sold, and million-seller status with every release! ICON OF DREAMS NI-KI #Twinkling20WithNI_KI #니시무라_미역국마니무라 #ニキ20歳の誕生日
